# best-indoor-plants-for-air-quality.com - Site Overview

> A science-backed guide to indoor plants that purify air, based on NASA Clean Air Study research. Covers 15 air-purifying plants with care guides, pet safety, and room-by-room recommendations.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://best-indoor-plants-for-air-quality.com/): Complete guide to 15 best indoor plants for air quality. Includes plant comparison table, category browser, and plant recommendation tool.
- [NASA Clean Air Study](https://best-indoor-plants-for-air-quality.com/nasa-clean-air-study): Deep dive into the 1989 NASA research that identified which houseplants filter benzene, formaldehyde, and trichloroethylene.
- [FAQ](https://best-indoor-plants-for-air-quality.com/faq): Science-backed answers to common questions about indoor plants and air quality.
- [Blog](https://best-indoor-plants-for-air-quality.com/blog): Expert articles on indoor plants, air quality, plant care, and science explainers.
- [About](https://best-indoor-plants-for-air-quality.com/about): Mission and methodology behind Air Purifying Plants Guide.
